name: DMARC Report
summary: DMARC Report is a DMARC monitoring service from DuoCircle. The Core plan is free and covers 1 domain and 10,000 messages a month. Paid self-serve plans run from $25 to $200 a month, with a 30-day trial. The Ultimate plan is listed at $3,900 one-time and is booked through a demo.

facts.text: Home page: DMARC Report turns aggregate (RUA) and forensic (RUF) reports into dashboards.
The home page names DuoCircle's sister product AutoSPF for dedicated SPF management.
The monitoring page describes authentication failure alerts when a DMARC pass rate drops, with a default threshold of 90%, and immediate notice when a previously unseen IP sends email as the domain.

For SPF, the monitoring page describes DNS lookup tracking, warnings as a record nears the 10-lookup limit, and flattening recommendations. For DKIM, it describes key age tracking and rotation reminders, with a default key age threshold of 90 days.
Prices are listed in USD on the pricing page. Annual billing is about 17% below monthly on Shield and Defender, but only about 8% below on Guard.

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: 30 days of history. Aggregate reports. The pricing page lists no alerts, API access or support for this plan.

plans.name: Guard
plans.notes: $275 a year if paid annually. 6 months of history. Aggregate and failure reports. No alerts or API access listed.

plans.name: Shield
plans.notes: $750 a year if paid annually. 1 year of history. MTA-STS and TLS-RPT, API access, email support and alerts.

plans.name: Defender
plans.notes: $2,000 a year if paid annually. Advanced failure reports, advanced API access and advanced support.

plans.name: Ultimate
plans.notes: Listed as a one-time price with no annual option. 3 years of history. A dedicated DMARC engineer. Booked through a demo.

hiddenCosts: The FAQ says all paid plans support unlimited domains, but the plan cards cap domains at 5, 10 and 25.
Alerts are listed from the Shield plan up. The pricing page does not list them for Core or Guard.
